config.notes: UQ course pages on study.uq.edu.au hold both a domestic and an international key-facts panel. The international panel reads: Location, Fees A$<amount>, Duration (one or more lines), Start Semester with dates (e.g. Semester 1 (22 Feb, 2027), Semester 2 (26 Jul, 2027); some programs start earlier, e.g. Semester 1 (26 Jan, 2027) or Summer Semester (29 Nov, 2027)), Program Code, CRICOS Code, AQF. Intakes, duration and campus are read from the international panel (anchored on 'Fees A$'); months come from the printed dates, so no term-to-month mapping is used (the generic calendar mapping is wrong for programs with their own dates). Fee is the international 'Indicative annual fee' block 'AUD $<amount> <year>' (the domestic/CSP block has no AUD prefix). IELTS from 'IELTS overall X' or 'IELTS score of X overall'. Central calendar: https://about.uq.edu.au/academic-calendar (Semester 1 = February, Semester 2 = July, Summer Semester = late November). Closing dates in 'Important dates' are application deadlines, not intakes. HDR pages (PhD/MPhil) carry no fee or start panel. Pages on programs-courses.uq.edu.au and faculty sites are left to the general reader.
